# RenderView layout (Int32Array)
Positions are Fixed Q16.16 (divide by 65536 for tiles).

## Header (16 × i32) — source of truth: `crates/web/src/view.rs` mod `h`, mirrored in `web/src/core/view-layout.ts`
| idx | field |
|---|---|
| 0 | frame |
| 1 | n_players (records, always 4) |
| 2 | n_enemies (alive only, compacted) |
| 3 | n_shots |
| 4 | wave |
| 5 | phase (0 intermission, 1 active, 2 game over) |
| 6 | phase timer (frames) |
| 7 | team score |
| 8 | combo |
| 9 | combo timer |
| 10 | unlocked weapon mask |
| 11 | local handle |
| 12 | session player count |
| 13 | best combo |
| 14 | enemies left to spawn |
| 15 | reserved |

## Records (appended in order, fixed stride)
| section | stride | fields |
|---|---|---|
| players | 10 (always 4 records) | x, y, hp, life, facing, weapon, hurt_flash, down_timer, revive, kills |
| enemies | 6 | slot, x, y, kind, hp_permille, stagger |
| shots | 4 | x, y, kind, dir |
